text: Handling deadlines well requires good planning. First, manage your time by breaking large tasks into smaller steps and setting a schedule. Next, prioritise your work: decide which tasks are most urgent and do them first. Sometimes you also need to manage the scope of a project. If you have too much to do, you may need to reduce what you include. Finally, communication is key. If you think you will miss a deadline, tell your manager or team early. They may offer help or more time. With these strategies, you can stay calm and meet your deadlines more successfully.
